# Md Hasibullah (Hasibullah Shanto), video editor and motion designer

Md Hasibullah, also known as Hasibullah Shanto (and Md Hasibullah Shanto), is a Bangladesh-based video editor and motion designer and the founder of Warmblu Studio. He has edited over 1,500 videos in his career for leading creators, AI companies and production studios in the US, Australia and Europe.

His edit of a Luma reel for tech creator Roberto P. Nickson passed 75 million views across Instagram and TikTok. He is the editor behind designer Tommy Geoco's short-form channel, with 41 videos delivered, and he edits for creator Daniel Do, for the AI companies Higgsfield and Invideo AI, and for the Sydney agency Think Studio, including a 1 million-view piece for Sonny Bill Williams. Production companies hire him too, among them 50 Blvd in San Francisco (the Tavus Phoenix-4 launch and the Virtue AI films) and Aliens Create in South Florida.

His signature is story-first pacing, motion design that matches a brand exactly, and sound design clients notice.

Website: https://hasibullahshanto.com (also https://mdhasibullah.com)
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hasibullah_shanto/
Studio: Warmblu Studio, https://www.instagram.com/warmblu.studio/
